_about: Settings for Melbourne's Routes page (engine/routes/: build.py, page.html), at /melbourne/routes/: pick a tram or bus stop or train platform near you, see where each route and line from it goes. The train lines come from raw/surface/rapid_*.json (surface.json 'rapid'), their platforms in order; V/Line stations count as connections too. Transport Victoria's GTFS-realtime feeds need an API key, so the page shows scheduled departures (surface.json 'sched'), not live times.
_keepRight: Australia drives on the left: stops for each direction are on the left of the road.

page.title: Where does this tram, bus or train go?
page.description: Find the tram and bus stops and train stations nearest you in Melbourne and see where each route goes, with the next scheduled departures: the suburbs it passes through, the main streets it runs along, its train and V/Line connections and the landmarks on the way.
page.lede: Find the stops and stations near you, then pick a tram, bus or train line to see where it goes: the suburbs, main streets, connections and landmarks along the way.
page.outside: That spot is outside the City of Melbourne. Try an address in the City.
page.noMatch: No match in the City of Melbourne for “{q}”. Try the full street address, like “90 Swanston Street”.
page.noStops: No stops or stations within {r} of that spot.
page.credits: Routes, stops and timetable: Transport Victoria GTFS (CC BY 4.0) · Suburbs: Australian Bureau of Statistics · Streets: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · Times are scheduled; live times need Transport Victoria’s keyed feed

_toStrip: toStrip: a pattern taken off a route's destination (its last stop's name). Transport Victoria ends tram stop names with the stop number ('Waterfront City/Docklands Dr #D11'): useful on a stop, noise in 'to Waterfront City/Docklands Dr'.

badges._about: Route badge colours for apps, as the web page draws them (factsheet.css): buses orange, trams green, both with white numbers; train lines are named, not lettered, so their bullets are plain dots ('label' empty) in the line group's colour; V/Line a purple pill.
